faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Kannur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 6 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Kannur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Overseer Grade II (Electrical), 1 Electrical Helper.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Kannur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 6 November 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kannur University Head Quarters, Thavakkara, Kannur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: Age relaxation as per Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹18,000 for Overseer Grade II (Electrical), ₹15,200 for Electrical Helper.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Overseer Grade II (Electrical): 3 years recognized diploma or equivalent in relevant subject, OR SSLC or equivalent with a Kerala government certificate (Biennial course) in relevant field or an 18 months Draftsman trade course with 6 months practical training at ITI/centre conducted by Ministry of Labour. Electrical Helper: ITI Certificate in Electrical Engineering. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Walk-in interview at 11:00 AM on 06.11.2026.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis for a period not exceeding 179 days or until an incumbent through employment exchange joins, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kannur University, Kannur.
